title: Prophecy of Tribulations and Guidance
summary: Prophet Muhammad warned about tribulations due to widespread immorality.
translation: Narrated by Hazrat Zainab bint Jahsh, may Allah be pleased with her, that one day the Prophet, may peace and blessings be upon him, came in seeming urgency and said, 'There is no deity worthy of worship other than Allah. Woe be upon the Arabs for an evil so near! A hole has been made in the wall of Gog and Magog like this,' and he formed a circle with his thumb and forefinger. Hazrat Zainab, may Allah be pleased with her, asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, will we be destroyed even though the righteous are among us?' He replied, 'Yes, if wickedness and immorality become widespread. When society is engulfed in sin and vice, the presence of scholars and pious people will not be able to prevent the calamities and tribulations that result from such immorality. Therefore, when sin becomes widespread, turn towards Allah, repent collectively, and increase in prayers and seeking forgiveness.'
